Package repository

Class FileRepository<ID,E extends Entity<ID>>

java.lang.Object
repository.InMemoryRepository<ID,E>
repository.FileRepository<ID,E>
Type Parameters:
ID - the type of the id of the entities
E - the type of the entities, which must extend Entity
All Implemented Interfaces:
Repository<ID,E>
public class FileRepository<ID,E extends Entity<ID>> extends InMemoryRepository<ID,E>
Repository that keeps the entities in memory, like InMemoryRepository, and also stores them in a text file, one entity per line. The file is read when the repository is created and rewritten after every change. The conversion between an entity and a line is given by two functions, so the same class works for any type of entity.

  • Constructor Details

    • FileRepository

      public FileRepository(Validator<E> validator, String fileName, Function<String,E> lineToEntity, Function<E,String> entityToLine, Supplier<ID> idGenerator)
      Creates the repository and loads the entities from the file, if it exists. The lines that cannot be loaded (invalid or duplicated) are ignored and reported on the console.
      Parameters:
      validator - the validator used to check the entities
      fileName - the path of the file where the entities are stored
      lineToEntity - converts a line of the file into an entity
      entityToLine - converts an entity into a line of the file
      idGenerator - supplies new ids for the entities saved without one; it may be null
      Throws:
      RepositoryException - if the file cannot be read
